approved_scope: Phase 2 study only; RF-F003 and RF-T005 remain unchanged; Phase 3 remains paused.
description: RF-T005-equivalent up to 3 independent variable C branches plus per-shunt-DTC fixed 0.5pF/Q40 ground parasitic. Non-ground (bridge/series) DTC has no such parasitic.
validation_notes: For each ground-shunt variable C branch, add a DISTINCT fixed C=0.5pF/Q40 in parallel between the identical node and GND, even at variable C=0. Each DTC variable component remains 0..3pF/Q35; aggregate shunt capacitance is 0.5..3.5pF (A), not capped at 3pF. Apply once per installed ground-shunt DTC; none on non-ground bridge/series DTC. No separate PCB_PATTERN_C budget consumption (its 0.02..0.2pF and maximum count 3 are unchanged), and no added chip area cost. Treat fixed 0.5pF and Q40 as constant over frequencies/settings in nominal Phase 2. Model two lossy admittances separately, Y=omega*Cvar/(1/35-j)+omega*(0.5pF)/(1/40-j). Node labels for EXP-042: Cv0 node4-GND, Cv1 node5-GND, Cv2 node2-node3 no parasitic. No new 3-6GHz RF-T006 extra stopband. Requires allow_trial=True and explicit parasitic branch stamping in each numerical circuit evaluator; metadata alone does not modify existing EXP-042 numerical scripts. Existing candidate IL/H2/H3 are not revalidated for RF-T007.
